dag_infos.description: Taiwan industrial and service employees' annual total salary by age and industry scope, with mean and median values for ROC 110-113.

data_infos.name_cn: 受僱員工全年總薪資（按年齡別及業別）
data_infos.source_type: 行政院主計總處官方統計表2 Excel
data_infos.dataset_description: 主計總處工業及服務業全體受僱員工全年總薪資統計表2，依業別提供全體、未滿25歲、25-29歲、未滿30歲、30-39歲、40-49歲、50-64歲及65歲以上的平均數與中位數。現行官方表2包含民國110至113年四個工作表，數值單位為萬元。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the official statistics page with a browser User-Agent, parse its server-rendered table-2 XLSX link, read the workbook with the standard-library XLSX package parser, and resolve the two-level measure/age headers by role rather than hard-coding a single cell. Age labels are converted to integer bounds; unparseable labels raise. Every numeric source cell emitted is reconciled by count and sum, and the comparable total rows receive a three-times-median scale guard. The ETL keeps the source age bands and overlapping under-25/under-30 scopes; it never materializes an 18-35 salary estimate.
